photoSubjects: High-end editorial photograph of an elegant woman in her late twenties or early thirties wearing a fitted beige yoga outfit, calmly performing a controlled Pilates exercise on her hands and knees with graceful extension and proper form on a professional wooden reformer, photographed with realistic skin texture and soft natural daylight in a luxury studio with large windows, warm beige walls, light wooden flooring, soft shadows and a subtle indoor plant; show her complete pose and the reformer.
prompt:
Create a premium, elegant, and minimalist promotional social media advertisement for a luxury Pilates and yoga studio named **"Balance Yoga & Pilates."** The design should have a sophisticated wellness aesthetic, combining warm neutral tones, refined typography, and a realistic lifestyle photograph.

**Main visual:** On the right side, feature a realistic, elegant woman in her late 20s or early 30s wearing a beige, fitted yoga outfit, performing a controlled Pilates exercise on a professional wooden Pilates reformer machine. She is positioned on her hands and knees, extending her body gracefully while maintaining proper form. Her expression is calm and focused. The studio should have large windows with soft natural daylight, warm beige walls, light wooden flooring, a wooden Pilates reformer, and a subtle indoor plant in the background. Use soft shadows, realistic skin texture, natural lighting, and high-end editorial photography.

**Layout and composition:**

* Use a split composition, with the left 45% reserved for text and the right 55% featuring the Pilates model and studio.
* Blend the photograph softly into the left side using a subtle cream-colored gradient overlay.
* Keep the design uncluttered, spacious, and premium, with carefully aligned text and clear visual hierarchy.
* Use an elegant palette of warm ivory, beige, muted taupe, and deep olive green.

**Text and typography:**

At the top left, place a refined brand logo featuring a minimal abstract leaf or flowing yoga-inspired symbol, followed by the brand name:

"Balance"
"YOGA & PILATES"

Below the logo, add a large, bold, sophisticated serif headline in deep olive green:

"Ready to
Master
Your Form?"

Use oversized editorial typography with strong contrast and tight but readable line spacing. Make "Ready to Master" especially prominent.

Under the headline, add a short, clean supporting paragraph in a simple sans-serif font:

"At Balance Pilates & Yoga, our small class sizes mean you get personalized attention to perfect every pose."

Add a thin decorative olive-green line beneath the headline or near the supporting text.

**Call-to-action section:**

In the lower-left area, include a circular dark olive-green icon with a white @ symbol. Place this text to its right in an elegant serif font:

"Find your
balance today"

At the bottom left, create a dark olive-green rectangular information panel with white text. Include a small white location pin icon and the location:

"Jumeirah Center, Dubai"

Add a thin white horizontal divider. Under the divider, display:

"Link in bio to book!"

Include a small white right-pointing arrow aligned to the right.

**Design quality:**

* Premium boutique fitness brand identity.
* Editorial magazine-style layout.
* Elegant contrast between oversized serif headlines and readable sans-serif body copy.
* Balanced spacing, subtle gradients, soft natural lighting, and photorealistic details.
* Clean, polished, professional social media advertisement suitable for Instagram.
* Preserve clear text alignment and ensure all text is correctly spelled, legible, and visually integrated into the composition.

The final design should feel calm, luxurious, modern, inviting, and focused on the benefits of personalized Pilates and yoga training.
